groups.saying_opens: أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أردف الفضل
أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم لم يزل يلبي

notes: Two sayings with a shared head: the Prophet's Muzdalifah ride (saying 1) and the talbiya until the jamra (saying 2), which Ibn Abbas reports from al-Fadl (rule 4a).
«قال ابن خشرم أخبرنا عيسى» gives the same transmitter with other wording: left out. «ابن عباس» and «الفضل» each stand twice, so occurrences are numbered.
